Name: Guardian containment prevents unsafe Brain dispatch
Description: Guardian quarantines a compromised port pump while the Brain requests an operational start command.
Expected: Twin: Rejects the command to PRT-PMP-01 with FAILED and GUARDIAN_RESTRICTED; it does not claim that the command ran.
Expected: Brain: Checks the restriction, records the rejection, queries compatible backups, and dispatches START to available PRT-PMP-02.
How to verify: Follow the quarantine, rejected command, compatible-device lookup, and backup command lifecycle in logs/scn-04-*.log.
